name: Plumas & Paetês
description: After an accident, Marcela arrives in São Paulo and decides to assume a new identity. Torn between love, she plunges into a world that is not her own.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: Rebeca catches Jorge kissing a female employee. Osmar reads Gustavo's letter and decides to return home with Júlia. Marcela asks Júlia to leave with her. Renato flees the city.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Ângelo is charmed by Lídia. Bruna proposes that Cláudia marry Edgar in a double ceremony with Osmar and Júlia. Osmar, Júlia, and Marcela travel. The friends suffer a serious accident.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: Marcela is rescued and taken to the hospital. Bruna and Gustavo discover that Osmar died in a car accident. Everyone believes that Marcela was Osmar's fiancée.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: Gustavo invites Marcela to live in the mansion. Jorge starts flirting with Nadir again. Veroca lies to Zequinha about Dorinha. Bruna visits Marcela.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: Bruna doesn't believe Marcela's explanation for not marrying Osmar in Belo Horizonte. Nadir tells her family about Jorge's advances. Márcio tries to kiss Rebeca.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Bruna criticizes Gustavo's excessive concern for Marcela. Márcio discovers that Sandra has a show scheduled. Marcela leaves the hospital.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: Sandra catches Ângelo talking alone with Lídia. Jorge decides to teach Nadir how to walk the runway and kisses her. Rebeca catches them kissing. Marcela arrives at the mansion.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: Rebeca decides against firing Nadir and advises her to stay away from Jorge. Bruna catches Edgar leaving Marcela's room and forbids him from approaching the girl. The priest looks for Márcio.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: Mario forbids Sandra from singing at the church festival. Rebecca threatens Jorge. Edgar praises Marcela to Gustavo. Jorge sends a note to Nadir.

videos.title: Chapter 10
videos.overview: Clóvis forces Nadir to go home. Jorge believes Nadir rejected him. Cláudia feels insecure about Edgar and Marcela's friendship. Zequinha discovers that Amanda is in love.

videos.title: Chapter 11
videos.overview: Amanda and Marcela come face to face for the first time. Renato calls home and moves Yara to tears. Jorge tells Rebeca that he brought a cake. Bruna makes a request to Marcela.

videos.title: Chapter 12
videos.overview: Bruna asks Marcela to talk about her life with Osmar and discovers that the young woman didn't know about her son's illness. Márcio exposes Sandra. Edgar gets closer to Marcela.

videos.title: Chapter 13
videos.overview: Márcio has a jealous outburst over Gino, sparking Rebeca's interest in the bodyguard. Sandra argues with Ângelo. Marcela feels dizzy. Bruna plots against Marcela.

videos.title: Chapter 14
videos.overview: Bruna exposes Marcela and questions her relationship with Osmar. Cláudia pressures Edgar. Gustavo defends Marcela and argues with Bruna. Chico catches Sandra and Ângelo together.

videos.title: Chapter 15
videos.overview: Clóvis catches Nadir kissing Jorge and drags his daughter home by the hair. Edgar decides to postpone the wedding. Marcela asks for shelter for the models. Jorge asks Melina out.

videos.title: Chapter 16
videos.overview: Bruna tells Irene and Cláudia that Edgar no longer wants to get married. Jorge humiliates Nadir and refuses to go out with her. Bruna catches Edgar and Marcela together.

videos.title: Chapter 17
videos.overview: Edgar confronts Bruna and says he's in love with Marcela. Bruna pressures Gustavo to kick Marcela out of the mansion. Renato considers returning home.

videos.title: Chapter 18
videos.overview: Marcela leaves the mansion and is greeted at the models' apartment by Veroca. Nadir decides to tell Rebeca the truth. Father Clodovil receives an unusual request.

videos.title: Chapter 19
videos.overview: Bruna reveals to Cláudia that Edgar is in love with Marcela. Jorge gives Nadir a gift. Cláudia seeks out Edgar and ends their relationship. Nadir is accused of stealing from the factory.

videos.title: Chapter 20
videos.overview: Jorge confesses that he gave the pants to Nadir. Edgar argues with Bruna and makes threats. Cláudia looks for Marcela and questions her feelings for Edgar. Ângelo receives a proposal.

videos.title: Chapter 21
videos.overview: Dorinha tries to convince Marcela to tell Osmar's family about the pregnancy. Lídia plots to separate Sandra and Ângelo. Osmar's seventh-day memorial mass begins.

videos.title: Chapter 22
videos.overview: Rebeca asks Gino to keep an eye on Nadir and Jorginho. Marcela and Edgar arrive together for mass, causing discomfort. Jorginho discovers that Rebeca is watching him and argues with his mother.

videos.title: Chapter 23
videos.overview: Yara meets Marcela and the two talk about Amanda and Renato's romance. Zequinha goes to Amanda's fashion show. Marcela rejects Edgar. Jorginho confronts Rebeca.

videos.title: Chapter 24
videos.overview: Márcio forbids Gino from approaching Rebeca. Bruna gets furious when Edgar warns that he won't give up on winning Marcela's heart. Veroca discovers that Jorginho is Rebeca's heir.

videos.title: Chapter 25
videos.overview: Melina gets jealous when she sees Veroca and Jorginho exchanging phone numbers. Ângelo invites Lídia out. Marcela accepts Edgar's invitation in front of Cláudia.

videos.title: Chapter 26
videos.overview: Nadir gets ready to go to the party. Ângelo and Lídia kiss. Márcio gets annoyed by Bianca's presence at his dinner with Rebeca. Jorginho prepares the house to receive Nadir.

videos.title: Chapter 27
videos.overview: Lídia gets bored listening to Ângelo talk about Sandra during their date. Jorginho seduces Nadir. Amanda describes Renato to Marcela, who notices similarities between him and Paulo.

videos.title: Chapter 28
videos.overview: Veroca discovers that Jorginho tried to seduce Nadir. Rebeca finds the house a mess and suspects Jorginho. Sandra cries when she realizes she missed her show.

videos.title: Chapter 29
videos.overview: Zequinha questions Chico and makes a discovery about Renato. Jorginho lies to Rebeca again. Amanda confronts Jorginho, but he reveals something about Nadir.

videos.title: Chapter 30
videos.overview: Cláudia denies to Rebeca that she was with Jorginho at the mansion. Gustavo confronts Bruna and announces that he will support Edgar in getting together with Marcela. Lídia provokes Sandra and takes a dig at Ângelo.

videos.title: Chapter 31
videos.overview: Nadir denies the accusations and convinces Amanda that Jorginho is lying. Bruna has a frank conversation with Marcela. Raul opens up about Renato. Jorginho asks Veroca out.

videos.title: Chapter 32
videos.overview: Zequinha invites Dorinha out. Márcio catches Ângelo sleeping in his house. Veroca notices that Jorginho is intimidated in her presence. Marcela reveals her secret to Edgar.

videos.title: Chapter 33
videos.overview: Edgar is overjoyed with the news of the pregnancy and promises to take responsibility for Marcela's baby. Melina is introduced at the agency. Jorginho declares his love for Nadir.

videos.title: Chapter 34
videos.overview: Bruna questions the paternity of Marcela's child. Rebeca discovers Jorginho's affair and decides to investigate Veroca. Dorinha is upset because she can't find work. Veroca provokes Melina.

videos.title: Chapter 35
videos.overview: Jorginho manages to trick Ângelo, and the two end up together for a night out. Veroca is furious when Jorge stands her up. Renato calls home. Márcio finds out about the show.

videos.title: Chapter 36
videos.overview: Márcio is suspicious of his children. Ângelo kisses Lídia. Jorginho makes Gino a financial offer to get closer to Nadir. Zenaide advises Rebeca.

videos.title: Chapter 37
videos.overview: Cristiano rejects Jorginho and offends Rebeca. Sandra discovers that Ângelo went to Lídia's house. Jorginho gives Nadir a gift and declares his love for her. Marcela decides to tell Dorinha the truth.

videos.title: Chapter 38
videos.overview: Jorginho insults Rebeca, saying that men approach her out of self-interest. Bruna calls Cláudia to investigate Marcela's past. Marcela makes a confession to Dorinha.

videos.title: Chapter 39
videos.overview: Marcela tells Dorinha details of her romance with Paulo. Rebeca gives Jorginho the cold shoulder. Time passes and Marcela goes into labor.

videos.title: Chapter 40
videos.overview: Marcela leaves the hospital with Paula. Edgar kisses Marcela. Jorginho rejects Nadir and argues with Veroca. Raul hires Ângelo. Lídia is suspicious of Melina's career.

videos.title: Chapter 41
videos.overview: Sandra has a jealous outburst when she sees Ângelo and Lídia talking. Luísa is disconcerted to learn about Edgar's crush on Marcela. Amanda talks to Renato on the phone.

videos.title: Chapter 42
videos.overview: Melina reveals to Cláudia her distrust of Luísa. Bruna offers to convince Marcela to marry Edgar. Luísa meets Marcela as Edgar's future wife.

videos.title: Chapter 43
videos.overview: Luísa pressures Edgar, who is rude to the girl and reveals he is in love with Marcela. Bianca tries to kiss Márcio. Ângelo kisses Cláudia.

videos.title: Chapter 44
videos.overview: Márcio discovers that Jorginho is dating Veroca. Yara meets Paula and is startled. Bruna supports Marcela and Edgar's marriage. Ângelo makes a decision.

videos.title: Chapter 45
videos.overview: Sandra is outraged by the breakup and pressures Ângelo. Jorginho pushes Nadir out of the car when she refuses to go out with him. Rebeca discovers who Veroca is.

videos.title: Chapter 46
videos.overview: Nadir tells her family that Jorge Luiz intends to marry her. Marcela shows her friends the ring she received from Edgar. Cláudia decides to change her attitude towards men.

videos.title: Chapter 47
videos.overview: Rebeca decides to throw a party at the mansion. Márcio excludes Lídia from the casting for the factory's fashion show. Marcela refuses to live in the mansion after the wedding.

videos.title: Chapter 48
videos.overview: Lídia reunites with Renato, who tells her he met a special woman in Minas. Rebeca is jealous of Gino. Cláudia arranges a meeting with Ângelo.

videos.title: Chapter 49
videos.overview: Yara cries upon seeing her son again, but Raul acts indifferently. Sandra catches Ângelo getting into a fancy car. Cláudia kisses Ângelo. Renato deceives Amanda.

videos.title: Chapter 50
videos.overview: Renato surprises Amanda and the two kiss passionately. Edgar goes out with Luísa. Clóvis tells Lídia that Ângelo went out with another woman.

videos.title: Chapter 51
videos.overview: Lídia confronts Ângelo. Nadir asks Jorge Luiz to go to her house and confirm the marriage story to her family. Luísa tells the models that Márcio vetoed Lídia from the fashion show.

videos.title: Chapter 52
videos.overview: Raul scolds Ângelo. Márcio asks Luísa to include Lídia in the fashion show. Renato goes to the models' apartment. Sandra and Lídia come face to face.

videos.title: Chapter 53
videos.overview: Sandra demands explanations from Ângelo. Jorge Luiz sabotages Veroca's dinner. Amanda asks if Renato met anyone on the trip. Melina finds Cláudia's thirst for revenge strange.

videos.title: Chapter 54
videos.overview: Nadir ruins Veroca's romantic dinner. Renato convinces Zeni and Clóvis that marriage is a mistake. Marcela and Edgar kiss in a romantic atmosphere.
